english.note: Use this colloquial alternative for the same handheld time-measuring device.

examples.english: When I run, I use a stopwatch myself to see whether this time is faster than last time.
examples.traditional: 我跑步嗰陣會自己撳碼錶，睇吓今次快唔快過上次。
